q: How does the step-by-step order form work?
a: Pick the sticker type, then the material, finish, size and quantity, upload artwork if you have it, and add your contact details. We price the job, suggest changes if a choice will not hold up, and send a free proof. Nothing is charged until you approve the proof.

q: What if I do not know which material to choose?
a: Choose the option that describes where the sticker will be used and leave the material on No preference. The surface, not the stock, decides the right film, and we pick it for you and explain why in the quote.

q: Can I enter a custom size?
a: Yes. Type the width and height in inches, or the longest side if the shape is irregular. We price by the bounding box of the shape, so a 3-inch circle and a 3-inch square cost the same. Sizes run from 0.5 inch to 24 by 36 inches.

q: Is the price shown on this page final?
a: The page does not show a price because material, size, finish and quantity interact. Your quote arrives by email within one business day with a per-sticker price and a total including free US shipping. Quotes are valid for 30 days.

q: Do I need finished artwork to use the form?
a: No. Upload what you have, even a photo of a sketch, or describe the design in the message field. Free design support covers cleaning files, setting a cut line and simple layouts. Vector files give the cleanest cut if you do have them.

q: Can I order more than one design through the form?
a: Yes. Describe each design and its quantity in the message, or send one form per design. Each is its own 100-piece run with its own price line, but they share a proof round and ship together.

The minimum is 100 per design. Per-sticker price drops noticeably at 250 and again at 500 and 1,000 because setup is spread over more pieces. If you are unsure, ask for two or three quantities in the message and we quote all of them.

q: How is my uploaded file handled?
a: Files are checked for type and size, attached to your enquiry email and never published or shared. Accepted formats are PDF, AI, EPS, SVG, PNG, JPG, WEBP and ZIP up to 10 MB. Larger files can be sent by link after we reply.

q: What happens if my chosen options will not work together?
a: We say so in the quote and propose the nearest combination that will. Typical cases are reflective film with matte finish, paper for a wet product, or a fine design at a tiny size. You are never charged for a job we think will fail.

q: Can I change my order after submitting the form?
a: Yes, at any point before you approve the proof. Reply to the quote with the change and we revise the price. After approval the job goes to press the same day, so later changes are treated as a new order.
